messages:
maria: Quick sync — prepping the private/VPC airgap bundle for tomorrow's delivery window. Need final release notes + explicit rollback gate text we can paste into the ops runbook.

sanjay: Copy. I'll list the rollout & rollback triggers. also tagging @ops for network handoff. :white_check_mark:

alex: Packaging finished locally, pushing signed submanifest now. ETA for transport handoff is 02:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Packaging job #472 succeeded. artifacts: installer-v2.8.1.tar.gz sha256=3a7f9c2b...; cosign signature OK.

lina: For release notes — do we need to call out quantization changes & model pin? customers usually want exact model+quant info in the notes.

maria: yes — call out: model version pinned to rw-model-1.5.0, quantized int8, known perf tradeoffs. Also note required KMS key rotation window.

sanjay: Rollback gate proposal (short):
- Abort and rollback if any of: installer exit errors > 5% across canary fleet during staging window; cosign verification failures during transport; mismatched checksums on target nodes; KMS unwrap failures on >1 node; critical post-install liveness probe fails (all nodes) for 10m.

alex: Agree. Operationally: we run a 50-node canary for 30m then ramp to 500 if green. deploy-bot will pin the manifest to the canary epoch before ramp.

maria: Draft release notes snippet (pasteable):

```
Redwood Private v2.8.1 (airgap) — release highlights:
- Installer: opaque offline bundle with signed submanifest (sha256: 3a7f9c2b...)
- Model: rw-model-1.5.0 (int8 quantized) — pinned for inference parity
- Security: cosign signatures and KMS-integrated decrypt at install time
- Notes: Customers must ensure outbound transport for key unwrap to KMS endpoint or pre-warm keys via KMExport tool.

If you experience installation checksums or signature errors, contact support and open an urgent delivery ticket.
```

lina: Can you add the known limitation note about metric retention? small paragraph.

maria: added offline: metric retention is disabled by default in airgap; instructions to enable are in docs link: https://internal.redwood/docs/airgap-metrics

ops-bot: @oncall Reminder: change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Emergency rollback SOP link: https://internal.redwood/wiki/rollback-sop

sanjay: Also adding a short command snippet for the ops runbook that we can paste under "rollback steps":

```
# lock new epoch and revert manifest
redwoodctl manifest pin --epoch previous-epoch
redwoodctl rollout cancel --selector private-vpc --reason "rollback: canary failures"
# revoke KMS unwrap grants if needed
kmsctl revoke --grant-id <grant>
```

alex: transport team: confirm you'll perform integrity checks on arrival and run `cosign verify` before unpack. Let me know if you want a checklist we can include in the transport manifest.

maria: +1 on checklist. I'll open a tiny PR to the release-notes repo and attach these exact snippets. After that, I want a final thumbs-up here and then I'll trigger the deploybot publish command.

deploy-bot: Scheduled publish task queued by maria — job 497. Current state: queued.

lina: :thumbsup: from docs side.

sanjay: :+1: from infra. If we see signature failures during arrival, immediate abort and manual rollback.

maria: Great — if no objections, I'm publishing at 01:45 UTC, 15m before transport handoff, so ops has the doc. Everyone ok?

alex: OK from packaging.

lina: OK.

sanjay: OK.

deploy-bot: Job 497 started: publishing release notes and manifest to staging.

ops-bot: Noted — oncall team alerted.

maria: thanks team. will update this thread with the PR link & final manifest epoch once published.
